audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 row said Karma on both layers while every why on the page (phases[4].why, whys[4]) said Wukong wins level 6. The packet levelChart also lists Wukong at index 4.
audit.why: Cyclone's double knockup on a 40s-Mantra enchanter with no dash decides level 6; the row contradicted its own explanation and the packet.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] flipped to Wukong as a matched pair, rating raised to 6/10. whys[1] rewritten to agree with win[1]='Skill' (it previously said level 2 was Karma's).

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 text implied Karma's empowered Q only arrives later; the page treated Mantra as a level-6-style spike.
audit.why: Riot's own text: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.' Her RQ poke at 950 range exists from the first wave.
audit.corrected: whys[0] states Mantra needs no point, so RQ lands at 950 from level 1. Spike list in breakdown.cooldowns now names Mantra's 40s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Focused Resolve was described only as 'her root tether' with no cooldown, and 'breaks if you LoS' — line of sight is not stated anywhere in Riot's text.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12 seconds at every rank (no rank scaling), which is what makes the trade window concrete. Riot's text says the tether roots 'if the tether is not broken' — distance-based; it does not mention line of sight.
audit.corrected: Cooldown windows, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t now say 'a flat 12-second root tether that breaks if you leave its leash' and drop the unverified LoS claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading lines used generic 'E' / 'Q' and called Karma 'he' / 'his'.
audit.why: Real ability names (Nimbus Strike, Crushing Blow) and correct pronouns are the approved quality bar.
audit.corrected: tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, report[3].t, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d rewritten in-band.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed placeholder entries ('Your committal tool', 'Your ultimate') and no numbers.
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the window actionable.
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve 12s flat; Mantra 40s and available from level 1.
